models.name: erp_hrm_time_guests
models.description: Temporary guest identities for unauthenticated visitors who need limited access before signing up or logging in. This table represents a lightweight pre-account identity used before a visitor becomes a registered member. It is intentionally isolated from authenticated account data and does not store credentials. Related guest session records are modeled separately in {@link erp_hrm_time_guest_sessions}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest identity record.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp used to retire temporary guest identities without hard deletion.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session records for unauthenticated guest visitors. This table stores the session identity and access context for a guest while they remain outside the authenticated member flow, and it links each session to exactly one {@link erp_hrm_time_guests} record.

The table is intentionally narrow because guest access is temporary and should not duplicate account or member profile data. Session ownership and lifecycle are tracked here only, while any guest identity details remain in the parent guest table.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the guest session record.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: Opaque token or identifier used to recognize the guest session during unauthenticated access.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address captured when the guest session is created or refreshed.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL associated with the guest session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL recorded for the guest session context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts with email/password credentials and global profile linkage for authenticated users.

This table is the authentication root for signed-in users. It stores the login identity and shared profile data that applies across every organization the user belongs to. Organization-specific access, sessions, recovery tokens, and email verification records are handled in separate tables owned by other components, so this table remains focused on durable account identity and account lifecycle.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the member account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique login email used to authenticate the member account.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password credential used for authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Global profile display name shared across organizations.

plainFields.name: avatar_image_url
plainFields.description: Optional global profile avatar image URL.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Optional global profile phone number.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_member_sessions
models.description:
Stores authenticated member session records for login tracking and security auditing. Each row represents one issued session for a member account and records the client context, creation time, and expiration time for session management and revocation.

This table belongs to the authorization boundary and references {@link erp_hrm_time_members} only in the child-to-parent direction. It supports member authentication flows, session listing, and security enforcement without storing derived account profile data or any non-session business state.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the member session record.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address recorded when the session was created or last refreshed.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current request URL or entry URL associated with the session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL captured for the session context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was issued.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session becomes invalid.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_member_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens for {@link erp_hrm_time_members} and tracks when each token was issued, expires, and is consumed.

Each record represents one password-reset request for a member account. The table is intentionally separate from the member identity record so reset credentials remain ephemeral, auditable, and easy to revoke without affecting the authenticated account itself.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Random password reset token used to verify the reset request.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Time when this reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Time when this reset token was successfully consumed, if it has been used.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the reset request.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the reset request.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for revoked or removed reset requests.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Stores email verification tokens used to confirm ownership of a member email address during registration or account activation.

Each row represents one verification token issuance for a specific member account. The table supports token expiration, one-time verification, and audit-friendly lifecycle tracking without duplicating profile or credential data. Verification is always linked to {@link erp_hrm_time_members} and must remain scoped to that authenticated account.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secret verification token used to validate ownership of the email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this verification token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully consumed and the email was verified.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for revoking unused verification records.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_organization_memberships
models.description:
Stores the association between a member account and an organization, including the membership status and whether this membership is the currently selected organization context for the member.

This table is the organization-scoped access link used to scope all subsequent tenant data access. It does not store role assignments, invitation metadata, or profile data; those concerns belong to the authorization and role components. The relationship is always maintained from the membership record to {@link erp_hrm_time_members} and {@link erp_hrm_time_organizations}, ensuring a single source of truth for organization membership.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Membership status within the organization, such as active or pending.

plainFields.name: is_selected_context
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this membership is the member's currently selected organization context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for logically removed memberships.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_employees
models.description:
Stores organization-scoped employee records for the ERP HRM and time tracking platform. Each record links a user account to one organization, assigns exactly one role within that organization, and captures the employee's department, position, employment type, and active or deactivated status.

This table is the authoritative employee identity within a tenant. It is used to scope access, manage organization membership-driven employment records, and support HR and time-tracking workflows without duplicating contract history or dashboard data in this entity.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the employee record.

plainFields.name: position_title
plainFields.description: Optional job title or position name for display and HR management.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Employment classification for the employee, such as full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current employment state, such as active or deactivated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_employee_contracts
models.description:
Stores historical employment contracts for employees within an organization. Each record captures one contract period, compensation terms, and working-time expectations for a specific employee.

This table is append-oriented and preserves past contract history as immutable records after activation. The current active contract for an employee is determined by its date range, while the application layer enforces the rule that only one active contract may exist at a time and that a new contract closes the previous one the day before the new start date. Related employee identity is referenced through {@link erp_hrm_time_employees}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the employee contract record.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: The date on which this employment contract becomes effective.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: The date on which this contract ends. A null value indicates the contract is ongoing.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: The compensation amount defined by this contract.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: The unit used to interpret the pay rate, such as hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: The expected number of working hours per week for this contract.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-text notes describing contract-specific terms or context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the contract record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the contract record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the contract record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_organizations
models.description:
Stores the core tenant record for each organization, including its identity, profile, ownership reference, and lifecycle state.

This table represents the root tenant entity for the platform. It keeps organization identity and lifecycle data in a normalized form, while editable configuration such as currency, timezone, and fiscal settings is stored in the separate organization settings table. The organization record is the anchor for tenant isolation and ownership management across the system.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the organization tenant record.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization display name used throughout the tenant UI.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional organization summary or profile text.

plainFields.name: logo_image_url
plainFields.description: Optional organization logo image URL for branding.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Organization lifecycle state such as active or deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_organization_settings
models.description:
Stores organization-level configuration and editable tenant preferences for {@link erp_hrm_time_organizations}. It contains the operational settings that govern fiscal and localization behavior for a single organization, while keeping identity and ownership in the parent organization record.

This table is designed as a dependent 1:1 extension of the organization root, so each organization has at most one settings row. The model is kept normalized and only includes atomic configuration fields that are directly editable at the tenant level.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the organization settings record.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: ISO currency code used for organization-wide monetary display and pay-related configuration.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: IANA timezone identifier used for organization-wide date and time interpretation.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Month number that defines the first month of the organization's fiscal year, using a 1-based calendar month value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this settings record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this settings record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this settings record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_departments
models.description:
Organization-scoped department records used to group employees and describe the internal internal structure of an organization. Supports an optional single parent department for one-level nesting.

Each department belongs to exactly one organization and may optionally reference a parent department within the same organization to represent a shallow hierarchy. The table stores only department identity and descriptive attributes; employee assignment and department-nullification behavior are handled by related tables outside this component.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name within the organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional department description for organizational context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for retained department records.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_roles
models.description:
Organization-scoped role definitions used to control employee access within a tenant. Built-in roles and custom roles are stored together, while the assigned permission set is managed through {@link erp_hrm_time_role_permissions}.

Each role belongs to exactly one organization and is uniquely identified by its name within that organization. Built-in roles such as Owner, Manager, and Employee are represented in this table and must be protected from deletion by application rules. Custom roles may be edited or removed when no employees are assigned to them, with employee-role assignment enforced through the employee domain.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the role record.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Role name unique within the organization, such as Owner, Manager, Employee, or a custom role name.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the role's purpose and intended access level.

plainFields.name: is_builtin
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the role is a protected built-in role managed by the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the role was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_permissions
models.description:
Approved permission catalog used to compose organization role permission sets.

This table stores the canonical list of permission keys recognized by the platform and their descriptions. It is referenced by {@link erp_hrm_time_role_permissions} so roles can be assigned a validated permission set without duplicating the permission vocabulary in application code.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Stable permission key used by the authorization layer, such as org:manage or project:view.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of what the permission allows.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for inactive permissions, if ever retired.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_role_permissions
models.description:
Stores the assignment of approved permissions to organization-scoped roles.

Each row represents one permission granted to one role, forming the many-to-many bridge between {@link erp_hrm_time_roles} and {@link erp_hrm_time_permissions}. The table contains only relational keys and standard temporal fields so permission sets remain normalized and can be audited over time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_projects
models.description:
Stores project records for a single organization, including the project identity, lifecycle status, schedule, budget, and display metadata.

Each project belongs to exactly one {@link erp_hrm_time_organizations} record and is managed within that tenant boundary. The table keeps only atomic project attributes and lifecycle timestamps; project membership, task assignment, and time-entry relationships are modeled in separate tables to preserve normalization.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the project record.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable project name used in lists, search, and project details.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional project description for context and planning notes.

plainFields.name: color_code
plainFields.description: Required UI display color code for the project.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status of the project: active, archived, or completed.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Optional estimated budgeted hours for the project.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional project start date.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Optional project end date.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_project_memberships
models.description:
Links employees to projects and stores the employee's role within each project assignment.

Each row represents one employee's membership in one project and carries only the assignment-specific role for that project. The table supports project staffing, lead assignment, and membership checks without duplicating employee, project, or organization data. Referenced entities remain in their owning tables: {@link erp_hrm_time_projects} and {@link erp_hrm_time_employees}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the project membership record.

plainFields.name: project_role
plainFields.description: Role of the employee within this project assignment, such as member or project lead.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project membership was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_tasks
models.description:
Work items within a project used to plan, track, and complete project delivery tasks.

Each task belongs to exactly one project and may optionally be assigned to one employee who is a member of that project. Tasks can have one level of subtasks through an optional self-referencing parent task relationship. Status changes are recorded in the separate task history table, while this table stores the current task state, priority, scheduling fields, and assignment metadata.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

foreignFields.name: parent_task_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task's {@link erp_hrm_time_tasks.id} for one-level subtask hierarchies.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title shown in project work lists and task details.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional task description containing work context and implementation notes.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current task workflow state.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task priority level used for planning and ordering.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Optional estimate of the effort required to complete the task.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional target completion date for the task.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for archived task records.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_task_history_entries
models.description: Immutable status-change history for tasks within a project. Each row records one transition from an old task status to a new task status, the exact time the change occurred, and the member who performed the update. This table supports audit trails and task timeline views while keeping task state itself in {@link erp_hrm_time_tasks}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the task history entry.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_member_id
foreignFields.description: The actor member's {@link erp_hrm_time_members.id} who changed the task status.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: The task status before the change.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: The task status after the change.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when the task status changed.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_timelogs
models.description:
Persistent time entry records captured by employees for specific work dates. Each row stores the logged duration, the employee who created the entry, the project it belongs to, and an optional task reference.

This table is the durable source of truth for time tracking. It supports weekly timesheets, timer-to-timelog conversion, and reporting workflows while remaining normalized so that organization scope, project ownership, and task validity are resolved through related parent entities rather than duplicated here.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key of the timelog record.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_member_id
foreignFields.description: Employee {@link erp_hrm_time_members.id} who owns and created the timelog.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project {@link erp_hrm_time_projects.id} that the logged time belongs to.

foreignFields.name: erp_hrm_time_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task {@link erp_hrm_time_tasks.id} associated with the logged time.

plainFields.name: work_date
plainFields.description: Calendar date of the work that was logged.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Logged duration in minutes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Free-text description of the work performed.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the logged time is billable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_timers
models.description: Stores the currently running work session for an employee in the time-tracking workflow. The record captures the live timer context, including when it started and which project and optional task it is attached to, until the timer is stopped or discarded. This table is lifecycle-bound to the timer flow and supports the rule that an employee can have at most one active timer at a time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the live timer session.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: The optional task's {@link erp_hrm_time_tasks.id} when the timer is started or edited.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer started running.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional free-text note describing the work being performed while the timer runs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timer record was soft deleted or discarded, if applicable.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly employee timesheets that collect timelogs and store submission and review status.

Each record represents one employee's timesheet for a single Monday-to-Sunday week. The table stores the sheet lifecycle, submission metadata, review metadata, and rejection details while the actual included timelogs are maintained through the separate timesheet-to-timelog join table to preserve normalization.

The timesheet belongs to exactly one employee and may optionally be reviewed by a member who approved or rejected it. A given employee can have only one timesheet per week.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the timesheet week. Must be a Monday.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the timesheet week. Must be a Sunday.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Timesheet lifecycle state: draft, submitted, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was submitted for approval.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was approved or rejected.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when a submitted timesheet is rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_timesheet_timelogs
models.description:
Links weekly timesheets to the timelogs included in each submission so the system can compose, lock, and review weekly time entries without duplicating time-entry data.

Each row represents exactly one association between a timesheet and a timelog. The table exists to support draft composition, submission locking, approval workflows, and traceable removal or re-inclusion of timelogs in a weekly timesheet while preserving normalized timelog storage in {@link erp_hrm_time_timelogs} and weekly ownership in {@link erp_hrm_time_timesheets}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet-timelog association was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this association was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for removing the association while preserving historical traceability.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_time_report_rows
models.description: Precomputed organization time-report rows used to serve time reporting queries efficiently. Each row represents an aggregated slice of logged time for an organization within a reporting date range, broken down by employee, project, task, and billable status as needed for filtering and report presentation. This table is read-only from the application perspective and is maintained by reporting jobs rather than user actions. It references {@link erp_hrm_time_organizations}, {@link erp_hrm_time_employees}, {@link erp_hrm_time_projects}, and {@link erp_hrm_time_tasks} through dimension keys when the slice is scoped to those entities.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the precomputed report row.

plainFields.name: report_date
plainFields.description: The calendar date represented by this aggregated report row.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Whether the aggregated time in this row is billable.

plainFields.name: logged_minutes
plainFields.description: Total logged minutes included in this report row.

plainFields.name: logged_hours
plainFields.description: Total logged hours included in this report row for convenient presentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this precomputed row was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this precomputed row was last refreshed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for obsolete report rows.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_project_budget_report_rows
models.description:
Precomputed project budget reporting rows for an organization. Each row stores the budgeted hours, actual logged hours, and utilization metrics for a project with a defined budget so reports and dashboards can query aggregates efficiently.

This table is a derived reporting projection and is not edited directly by business users. It is designed for tenant-scoped analytics, period-based refreshes, and fast filtering by organization and project.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key for the precomputed report row.

plainFields.name: report_date
plainFields.description: Date or refresh timestamp representing when this reporting row was generated.

plainFields.name: period_start_date
plainFields.description: Start of the reporting window used to compute the metrics.

plainFields.name: period_end_date
plainFields.description: End of the reporting window used to compute the metrics.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Planned budgeted hours for the project within the report context.

plainFields.name: actual_hours
plainFields.description: Actual hours logged against the project within the report context.

plainFields.name: utilization_percent
plainFields.description: Percentage of budget consumed by actual logged hours for the report context.

plainFields.name: billable_hours
plainFields.description: Total billable hours logged against the project within the report context.

plainFields.name: non_billable_hours
plainFields.description: Total non-billable hours logged against the project within the report context.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_weekly_summary_report_rows
models.description:
Precomputed weekly summary rows for organization-level time reporting and dashboard analytics. Each row represents one organization and one ISO week, storing aggregate metrics for total hours, timelog volume, and active employees who logged time during that period.

This table is a derived reporting projection rather than a source of truth. It exists to speed up date-range filtering and weekly aggregation queries without duplicating transactional time-tracking records.

primaryField.name: id

models.name: erp_hrm_time_organization_dashboard_summaries
models.description:
Materialized organization dashboard snapshot that stores precomputed aggregate metrics for an organization's operational overview.

This projection supports fast dashboard rendering for report users by caching organization-level counts and summary values such as active employee totals, pending timesheets, weekly hours, and budget-risk project indicators. It belongs to the Reports component as derived data and references the owning organization as its tenant scope.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_employee_dashboard_summaries
models.description:
Stores a derived dashboard snapshot for each employee, summarizing personal time-tracking and workload metrics used by the employee dashboard.

The record is a reporting projection rather than a source-of-truth transactional table. It is keyed by employee and captures current-state or precomputed metrics such as hours logged today, hours logged this week, whether an active timer exists, the most recent timelog references, pending timesheet status for the current week, and counts or identifiers for assigned in-progress tasks. Detailed underlying facts remain in {@link erp_hrm_time_timelogs}, {@link erp_hrm_time_timers}, {@link erp_hrm_time_timesheets}, and {@link erp_hrm_time_tasks}.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: hours_logged_today
plainFields.description: Precomputed total hours logged by the employee for the current day.

plainFields.name: hours_logged_this_week
plainFields.description: Precomputed total hours logged by the employee for the current week.

plainFields.name: has_active_timer
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the employee currently has a running timer.

plainFields.description: Timestamp when the current active timer started, if one is running.

plainFields.name: recent_timelog_count
plainFields.description: Number of recent timelogs represented in the dashboard snapshot.

plainFields.name: pending_timesheet_status
plainFields.description: Current status of the employee's timesheet for the active week, such as draft, submitted, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: recent_timelog_snapshot_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the recent timelog portion of the dashboard snapshot was last refreshed.

plainFields.name: assigned_open_task_count
plainFields.description: Count of assigned tasks in open or in-progress status for the employee.

plainFields.name: assigned_in_progress_task_count
plainFields.description: Count of assigned tasks currently in progress for the employee.

models.name: erp_hrm_time_activity_log_entries
models.description:
Append-only audit trail entries for significant actions performed within an organization. Each record stores the organization scope, the acting member, the action type, the affected target entity, the event timestamp, and a human-readable details field for traceability.

This table is designed for immutable activity history and operational auditing. It supports administrative review, security analysis, and business event inspection without duplicating domain state from {@link Organization}, {@link Member}, or other business entities.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Canonical activity type such as employee invitation, contract change, project lifecycle action, task status change, timesheet review, or role assignment.

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Domain entity type affected by the action, stored as a normalized textual discriminator.

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the affected target entity within the organization.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Human-readable audit details describing what changed or why the event was recorded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the activity event occurred.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for retention workflows, if ever required.
